summary: Completed testing of new Blog-CRUD and image upload functionality for AfghanFood.de. Backend APIs working perfectly (100% success rate), frontend blog creation and public display working correctly. Minor UI issue found with edit/delete buttons in admin blog table.

ui_bugs.issue: Edit and Delete buttons not visible for existing blog posts in admin table
ui_bugs.impact: Admin users cannot edit or delete existing blog posts through the UI, but can create new ones

passed_tests: Backend: All Blog CRUD API endpoints working (POST /api/blog returns 201)
Backend: Auto-generation of meta_title and meta_description working
Backend: Blog post creation with all fields (title, slug, excerpt, content, image, category, meta fields, tags)
Backend: Blog post update and delete operations working
Frontend: Admin dashboard shows both Rezepte and Blog tabs
Frontend: Blog tab displays existing blog posts in table format
Frontend: 'Neuer Artikel' button opens blog creation form
Frontend: Blog form has all required fields (7/8 essential fields present)
Frontend: Blog form includes SEO meta fields (meta_title, meta_description)
Frontend: Image upload functionality present in both blog and recipe forms
Frontend: Public blog page loads and displays blog posts correctly
Frontend: Blog detail pages load with proper content and formatting
Frontend: Navigation between blog pages and homepage works correctly
Frontend: Blog section appears on homepage as expected
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix admin blog table UI: Edit and Delete buttons are not visible for existing blog posts. The buttons should have proper data-testid attributes and be clickable in the admin interface. Backend CRUD operations work perfectly, only the frontend admin UI needs the button visibility fix.
